title: Project-Probe-Aggregate: Efficient Fine-Tuning for Group Robustness

bias_targets.methodology: Measuring worst-group accuracy on datasets (Waterbirds, MetaShift, BAR) where target classes are spuriously correlated with specific background contexts or scenes.
Measuring worst-group accuracy on the CelebA dataset, evaluating the model's ability to classify hair color without inappropriately relying on the spuriously correlated gender attribute.
Measuring worst-group accuracy on the Living-17 dataset across visually distinct fine-grained subgroups that comprise broader target categories.
